newsitem.title: USA: Texas Utilities restores 575 MW coal plant.
newsitem.headline: Texas Utilities restores 575 MW coal plant.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co restored operations at a 575 megawatt (MW) coal-fired unit at its Big Brown generating station after it was taken off line Wednesday, the company said Friday.
A company spokeswoman could not elaborate on the reason for idling the Big Brown unit, but noted it was unplanned.
The Big Brown facility has another 575 MW unit, which has been operating normally.
The Big Brown station is 90 miles southeast of Dallas near the town of Fairfield.
